scripts.build: pnpm build:docs-components && pnpm build:landing && pnpm build:docs
scripts.build:docs: npm_config_cache=.npx-cache npx -y @pmndrs/docs@4.1.2 build docs dist/docs --format website --libname "@pmndrs/glyph" --libname-short glyph --libname-dotsuffix-label docs --libname-dotsuffix-href https://docs.pmnd.rs --icon ♠️ --github https://github.com/pmndrs/glyph --discord https://discord.gg/poimandres --home-redirect /getting-started/introduction --theme-primary "#0a0c12" --theme-scheme neutral --theme-contrast 0 && pnpm copy:docs-assets
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build:docs-components && pnpm check:docs && pnpm build:landing
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check docs/components landing/src scripts .oxlintrc.json package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
